The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Bug: the refill condition used `timer == rate - 1` and never special-cased `rate == 0`, so when `rate == 0`, `rate - 1` underflowed to all-1s, causing spurious refills instead of disabling them, and the timer wasn't forced to 0 while `rate == 0`. Also `==` instead of `>=` meant a mid-period reduction of `rate` past the current `timer` value wouldn't trigger an immediate refill as required. Fixed `refill` to `(rate != 0) && (timer >= rate - 1)` and added an explicit timer-reset-to-0 when `rate == 0`.
